svg.title: Ishikari metro map, readable

g.title: Ishikari metro map: How to read this map. Click for more.
g.text: Read it like a page: each row left to right, then wrap to the next row.

g.title: Row 1: 1 ASK · 2 PLAN Click for more.
Row 2: 3 BUILD · 4 CHECK · 5 FIX Click for more.
Row 3: 6 FINISH: MERGE · CLEANUP Click for more.
Row 4: 6 FINISH: JUDGE · MAIN MOVES Click for more.
Plan line: Rows 1 to 2: from your task to the worker plans. Click for more.
Question line: The investigator asks you, you answer. Click for more.
Research line: The investigator sends researcher ants. Click for more.
Build line: Rows 2 to 4: build, check, merge, judge, finish. Click for more.
Fix loop: A bug goes back to the worker and is re-checked. Click for more.
Clash line: Tasks that break together go back to the fix loop. Click for more.
Dropped spur: A task that could not be fixed leaves here. Click for more.
Merge failed spur: A failed merge goes back to the worker ants. Click for more.
Cleanup failed spur: A failed cleanup becomes a suggested next task. Click for more.
Judge fix loop: Below 7 with gaps: one fix round. Click for more.
After main moves: Green: the run's work is on main. Click for more.
Check failed spur: A failed app check starts one new task. Click for more.
Row wrap: to row 2 Click for more.
Merge failed spur: merge failed: to Worker ants, row 2 Click for more.
g.text: merge failed: to Worker ants, row 2
the worker merges main and fixes it;

g.title: Junction: Where the dropped spur leaves the line. Click for more.
Dropped spur: dropped Click for more.
g.text: after 3 tries on a bug or

g.title: Cleanup failed spur: cleanup failed: to Task, row 1 (next run) Click for more.
g.text: cleanup failed: to Task, row 1 (next run)
branch kept; its note is offered

g.title: Check failed spur: check failed: to Worker ants, row 2 (new task) Click for more.
g.text: check failed: to Worker ants, row 2 (new task)
one build round from the moved main;

g.title: Saved workflow: a plan may run a saved workflow in place of a worker ant Click for more.
g.text: a plan may run a saved workflow in place of a worker ant

g.title: Detective starts at once: built: the script starts Click for more.
Fix loop rule: bugs: the detective's fix plan goes back to the worker; Click for more.
g.text: bugs: the detective's fix plan goes back to the worker;
the worker builds it, the detective re-checks; 3 tries per bug

g.title: Row wrap: to row 3 Click for more.
Row wrap: to row 4 Click for more.
Clash rule: fail: tasks clash: the task takes Click for more.
g.text: fail: tasks clash: the task takes
them in, then the fix loop; 2 rounds

g.title: Judge passed: 7+, or no gaps: no fix round Click for more.
g.text: 7+, or no gaps: no fix round

g.title: Judge fix rule: below 7 and gaps: one fix round Click for more.
g.text: below 7 and gaps: one fix round

g.title: Failed judge fix: a failed fix keeps its branch; Click for more.
g.text: a failed fix keeps its branch;

g.title: Task (r1s1): The work you hand Ishikari. Click for more.
Investigator ant (r1s2): Asks you questions, then writes the investigation report. Click for more.
g.text: one live agent run by the skill: reads
the repo once, gets each answer as a message;
no Agent tool: the plan workflow runs it

g.title: You (r1s4): You answer the investigator's questions. Click for more.
g.text: 8 in all; answering approves the whole run

g.title: Researcher ants (r1s3): Look up facts for the investigator. Click for more.
g.text: up to 5 at once, web + computer,

g.title: investigation_report.md (r1s5): Everything learned while planning, written once. Click for more.
Add requirement ant (r1s6): Drafts the requirement entry; skipped with no requirements file. Click for more.
g.text: the main session pipes it into ishikari.py req add;
no requirements file: no add requirement ant

g.title: Architect ant (r1s8): Writes architecture.md and one plan per task. Click for more.
Worker plans (r1s9): One complete plan per task. Click for more.
g.text: one per task: title, files, after;

g.title: Logbook (r1s7): Every ant's reply, one entry each. Click for more.
g.text: logbook clerk ant: appends each ant's entry
the moment the ant replies, one clerk at a time, in plan, build and finish.
The live investigator gets only an investigated entry.
Build and finish add a summary at the end. No ant reads it.

g.title: Worker ants (r2s1): Build the plans, one worktree each. Click for more.
Detective ants (r2s2): Check each built task and plan every fix. Click for more.
g.text: one per built task: checks it against plan +
design, runs tests (reuses the worker's if clean);
finds each bug's cause and plans its fix

g.title: Integrator ant (r2s3): Merges all passing tasks in a scratch copy and tests once. Click for more.
g.text: merges passing tasks in a scratch
copy, tests once: the combined test;
fewer than 2 passing tasks: no combined test

g.title: Merger ant (r3s1): Merges the approved tasks for real, then checks with git; failures go back to the workers. Click for more.
g.text: merges in a straight line in a scratch copy,
or reuses build's trial merge; then checks
its own merge with git cherry

g.title: Janitor ant (r3s2): Cleans up mess the run left, by itself. Click for more.
g.text: cleans up dead code and mess itself: edits,
runs the tests, commits, lands it only if
they pass. Skipped under 100 changed lines;
a cleanup run has no janitor

g.title: Juror ants (r4s1): Score each merged task against its plan. Click for more.
g.text: one per merged task, 5 at once;

g.title: Judge ant (r4s2): Scores the whole run 0-10 against the plans. Click for more.
g.text: scores the run 0-10: does the code
match the plans? its own call, not an average

g.title: Worker ant (r4s3): Closes the judge's gaps. Click for more.
Detective ant (r4s4): Checks the judge fix. Click for more.
g.text: checks the fix, runs the tests

g.title: Merger ant (r4s5): Lands the judge fix by fast-forward. Click for more.
g.text: fast-forwards the scratch copy to the fix;
the fix lands only through this fast-forward

g.title: Judge ant (r4s6): Scores again after the fix. Click for more.
Finisher ant (r4s7): Moves main, cleans up, runs the check. Click for more.
g.text: appends the stage rows, runs the check

g.title: MAIN (r4s8): Your main branch, moved forward. Click for more.
checkCommand (r4s9): Builds and checks the app after main moves. Click for more.
g.text: the finisher ant builds and checks the app,
only when main moved and checkCommand is set

g.title: req done (r4s10): Marks this run's requirements DONE. Click for more.
g.text: the main session marks the kept :ID:s
once the check passed, or there is none

Read the map like a page: each row left to right, then wrap to the next. Hexagons are ants (AI agents), pages are files, dashed lines are side branches, and colour means something: green done, red failed, yellow warning. Click anything to learn what it is; Esc closes this panel.","src":"skills/ishikari/design/index.md","x":40,"y":44},{"id":"to-row-2","name":"Row wrap","code":"","tip":"to row 2","about":"The line continues on the next row; read the map like a page.","src":"","x":1912,"y":290},{"id":"saved-workflow","name":"Saved workflow","code":"","tip":"a plan may run a saved workflow in place of a worker ant","about":"A plan may name another saved workflow as its job. The build script then runs that workflow in place of a worker ant, so Ishikari can drive other workflows.","src":"","x":262,"y":432},{"id":"built","name":"Detective starts at once","code":"","tip":"built: the script starts","about":"No ant watches for finished work: the build script starts every ant, so it starts the task's detective the moment the worker returns.","src":"","x":480,"y":494},{"id":"bugs","name":"Fix loop rule","code":"","tip":"bugs: the detective's fix plan goes back to the worker;","about":"The detective's fix plan goes back to the worker, the worker builds it, and the detective re-checks every open bug by id. 3 tries per bug.","src":"","x":240,"y":664},{"id":"to-row-3","name":"Row wrap","code":"","tip":"to row 3","about":"The line continues on the next row; read the map like a page.","src":"","x":1912,"y":700},{"id":"to-row-4","name":"Row wrap","code":"","tip":"to row 4","about":"The line continues on the next row; read the map like a page.","src":"","x":1912,"y":1240},{"id":"clash","name":"Clash rule","code":"","tip":"fail: tasks clash: the task takes","about":"A task whose merge breaks the combined test takes in the tasks it clashes with, then goes through the fix loop. 2 rounds.","src":"","x":1212,"y":690},{"id":"no-fix","name":"Judge passed","code":"","tip":"7+, or no gaps: no fix round","about":"Green: a score of 7 or more, or no gaps, means no fix round and main moves.","src":"","x":720,"y":1506},{"id":"fix-round","name":"Judge fix rule","code":"","tip":"below 7 and gaps: one fix round","about":"A score below 7 with gaps starts one fix round.","src":"","x":440,"y":1612},{"id":"fix-fails","name":"Failed judge fix","code":"","tip":"a failed fix keeps its branch;","about":"Red: if the judge's fix fails, its branch is kept, main moves anyway and the verdict says why.","src":"","x":740,"y":1720},{"id":"key","name":"Key","code":"","tip":"What the cars, symbols and colours mean.","about":"Left: what each numbered car shows. Right: the symbols: hexagon an ant, bin dropped, circle an interchange, stacked shapes parallel ants, dashed a side branch. Bottom: green done, red failed, yellow warning, blue plan, indigo build.","src":"","x":1440,"y":1770},{"id":"row-1","name":"Row 1","code":"","tip":"1 ASK · 2 PLAN","about":"Steps 1 and 2: the investigator asks you its questions, then the plan stage writes the requirement, the design and one plan per task. The only row where you are asked anything.","src":"skills/ishikari/SKILL.md","x":1970,"y":120},{"id":"row-2","name":"Row 2","code":"","tip":"3 BUILD · 4 CHECK · 5 FIX","about":"Steps 3 to 5: worker ants build the plans in parallel, detective ants check each one and plan fixes, and the integrator tests all passing tasks together.","src":"skills/ishikari/SKILL.md","x":1970,"y":440},{"id":"row-3","name":"Row 3","code":"","tip":"6 FINISH: MERGE · CLEANUP","about":"Step 6, first half: the merger lands the tasks in a scratch copy and the janitor cleans up after them. Main has not moved yet.","src":"skills/ishikari/SKILL.md","x":1970,"y":980},{"id":"row-4","name":"Row 4","code":"","tip":"6 FINISH: JUDGE · MAIN MOVES","about":"Step 6, second half: the judge scores the run against the plans, the finisher moves main forward and runs the check, and the requirements are marked done.","src":"skills/ishikari/SKILL.md","x":1970,"y":1420},{"id":"line-plan","name":"Plan line","code":"","tip":"Rows 1 to 2: from your task to the worker plans.","about":"The blue line carries one task from Task through the investigator, the report, the requirement and the architect to the worker plans, then wraps down to row 2 where building starts.","src":"","x":60,"y":370},{"id":"line-ask","name":"Question line","code":"","tip":"The investigator asks you, you answer.","about":"The investigator's questions go up to you and your answers come back as messages to the same live agent. The dot riding it is one round of questions.","src":"","x":440,"y":90},{"id":"line-res","name":"Research line","code":"","tip":"The investigator sends researcher ants.","about":"Up to 5 researcher ants at once look things up and report back down this line while the investigator waits. The dot riding it is one burst of research.","src":"","x":440,"y":300},{"id":"line-g1","name":"Build line","code":"","tip":"Rows 2 to 4: build, check, merge, judge, finish.","about":"The indigo trunk carries every task from the worker ants through checking, the combined test, the merge, the cleanup and the judge to MAIN. The numbered cars on it are worker tasks.","src":"","x":1900,"y":1080},{"id":"line-fix","name":"Fix loop","code":"","tip":"A bug goes back to the worker and is re-checked.","about":"Yellow means a warning: the detective found a bug and planned its fix. The worker builds the fix and the detective re-checks, up to 3 tries per bug and 3 fix rounds.","src":"","x":230,"y":640},{"id":"line-clash","name":"Clash line","code":"","tip":"Tasks that break together go back to the fix loop.","about":"When the integrator's combined test shows two passing tasks clash, the task takes in the tasks it clashes with and goes back through the fix loop. 2 rounds at most.","src":"","x":800,"y":700},{"id":"line-drop","name":"Dropped spur","code":"","tip":"A task that could not be fixed leaves here.","about":"After 3 tries on one bug or 3 fix rounds the task drops, and tasks built on it drop too. Its branch is kept for a later look and the final report lists it.","src":"","x":660,"y":730},{"id":"line-mback","name":"Merge failed spur","code":"","tip":"A failed merge goes back to the worker ants.","about":"A conflict, failed tests, or a task git cannot find goes back to the worker ant on its own branch: it merges main and fixes it, then the detective, integrator and merger run again. At most 2 extra build rounds.","src":"","x":200,"y":1160},{"id":"line-tnext","name":"Cleanup failed spur","code":"","tip":"A failed cleanup becomes a suggested next task.","about":"If the janitor's tests fail, main moves with the tasks alone, the cleanup branch is kept, and its note is offered as the Task of the next run.","src":"","x":760,"y":1180},{"id":"line-jfix","name":"Judge fix loop","code":"","tip":"Below 7 with gaps: one fix round.","about":"Yellow means a warning: the judge scored the run below 7 and listed gaps. A worker closes them, a detective checks, the merger fast-forwards the fix, and the judge scores again. Only one round.","src":"","x":1000,"y":1610},{"id":"line-after","name":"After main moves","code":"","tip":"Green: the run's work is on main.","about":"After MAIN moves the finisher runs the check, and the main session marks the requirements done.","src":"","x":1780,"y":1520},{"id":"line-cfix","name":"Check failed spur","code":"","tip":"A failed app check starts one new task.","about":"If checkCommand fails after main moved, one build round runs as a new task named check-fix, from the moved main. Still failing: the run stops and requirements are not marked done.","src":"","x":1580,"y":1690},{"id":"spur-mback","name":"Merge failed spur","code":"","tip":"merge failed: to Worker ants, row 2","about":"A conflict, failed tests, or a task git cannot find goes back to the worker ant on its own branch: it merges main and fixes it, then the detective, integrator and merger run again. At most 2 extra build rounds.","src":"","x":200,"y":1160},{"id":"junction-drop","name":"Junction","code":"","tip":"Where the dropped spur leaves the line.","about":"Not a station: the point where the dropped spur branches off. After 3 tries on one bug or 3 fix rounds the task drops, and tasks built on it drop too. Its branch is kept for a later look and the final report lists it.","src":"","x":660,"y":640},{"id":"spur-drop","name":"Dropped spur","code":"","tip":"dropped","about":"After 3 tries on one bug or 3 fix rounds the task drops, and tasks built on it drop too. Its branch is kept for a later look and the final report lists it.","src":"","x":660,"y":730},{"id":"spur-tnext","name":"Cleanup failed spur","code":"","tip":"cleanup failed: to Task, row 1 (next run)","about":"If the janitor's tests fail, main moves with the tasks alone, the cleanup branch is kept, and its note is offered as the Task of the next run.","src":"","x":760,"y":1180},{"id":"spur-cfix","name":"Check failed spur","code":"","tip":"check failed: to Worker ants, row 2 (new task)","about":"If checkCommand fails after main moved, one build round runs as a new task named check-fix, from the moved main. Still failing: the run stops and requirements are not marked done.","src":"","x":1580,"y":1690},{"id":"task","name":"Task","code":"r1s1","tip":"The work you hand Ishikari.","about":"Your task in your own words, or the note of a cleanup the last run dropped. Setup makes the run's state folder and env first; the main checkout must be on the main branch with no uncommitted changes.","src":"SKILL.md#1-setup","x":120,"y":200},{"id":"investigator","name":"Investigator ant","code":"r1s2","tip":"Asks you questions, then writes the investigation report.","about":"One live agent run by the skill, not a workflow: it reads the repo once and gets each answer as a message. It critiques the task, finds the test command, and asks up to 4 independent questions at a time, about 8 in all. It stops once nothing important is unclear. Without the Agent tool the plan workflow runs it instead.","src":"assets/prompts/investigator.md, SKILL.md#2a-live-investigator","x":440,"y":200},{"id":"you","name":"You","code":"r1s4","tip":"You answer the investigator's questions.","about":"The only time Ishikari asks you anything. Questions come through /ask-simple, up to 4 at a time, about 8 in all. Answering approves the whole run, merge to main included.","src":"SKILL.md#2a-live-investigator","x":440,"y":90},{"id":"researchers","name":"Researcher ants","code":"r1s3","tip":"Look up facts for the investigator.","about":"Up to 5 at once, 2 bursts per question. They search the web and the whole computer, read only, never secrets, and report back. The investigator waits for them. Not logged when the live investigator sends them.","src":"SKILL.md#limits","x":440,"y":300},{"id":"report","name":"investigation_report.md","code":"r1s5","tip":"Everything learned while planning, written once.","about":"Goal, scope, every decision you made, facts with sources, constraints, risks, assumptions, acceptance checks and commands. Every claim cites an answer, a fact or the repo. Later ants read it instead of asking you. The main session never edits it.","src":"<state>/plans/<run>/investigation_report.md","x":780,"y":200},{"id":"add-requirement","name":"Add requirement ant","code":"r1s6","tip":"Drafts the requirement entry; skipped with no requirements file.","about":"Reads only the report and the repo; the report wins. Drafts the entry with /add-requirement and shows it can be built, with a throwaway spike only if needed. Never asks, designs or plans. The main session pipes the entry into ishikari.py req add. Runs only when setup finds requirements.org or requirements/*.org.","src":"scripts/ishikari-plan.js (Requirement phase)","x":1100,"y":200},{"id":"architect","name":"Architect ant","code":"r1s8","tip":"Writes architecture.md and one plan per task.","about":"Designs the parts of the change, the files each owns, and every name, interface and data shape between them, so parallel workers fit. Maps each acceptance check to a part. Splits the work into tasks of about 3 files, no two editing one file, each with its own test file.","src":"scripts/ishikari-plan.js (Design phase)","x":1420,"y":200},{"id":"plans","name":"Worker plans","code":"r1s9","tip":"One complete plan per task.","about":"Workers cannot ask questions, so each plan is complete: title, files, after. The plan script rejects bad or unknown ids, loops in after, two tasks on one file, and a bad requirement, before anything is built.","src":"<state>/plans/<run>/<task>.md","x":1700,"y":200},{"id":"logbook","name":"Logbook","code":"r1s7","tip":"Every ant's reply, one entry each.","about":"A recfile the logbook clerk appends to the moment an ant replies, one clerk at a time. Build and finish add a summary at the end. No ant reads it; read it with ishikari.py log status, recsel or an editor.","src":"~/.ishikari/<repo>-<hash>/logbook.rec","x":1370,"y":40},{"id":"workers","name":"Worker ants","code":"r2s1","tip":"Build the plans, one worktree each.","about":"Up to 5 at a time, each in its own git worktree. Writes code, tests and the docs its change affects, decides on its own and commits all its work. A worker that gets stuck says why, and that becomes a bug for the next fix round. A plan may name a saved workflow to run instead.","src":"scripts/ishikari-build.js","x":200,"y":540},{"id":"detectives","name":"Detective ants","code":"r2s2","tip":"Check each built task and plan every fix.","about":"One per task, started as soon as it is built. Checks the work against its plan and architecture.md, and runs the tests. Each bug comes back with how to see it, its cause and a fix plan; a worker builds the fix and the detective re-checks. 3 tries per bug, 3 fix rounds, then the task drops. Never changes code. A dropped task's branch is kept for a later look, tasks built on it drop too, and the final report lists them.","src":"scripts/ishikari-build.js","x":760,"y":540},{"id":"integrator","name":"Integrator ant","code":"r2s3","tip":"Merges all passing tasks in a scratch copy and tests once.","about":"Two tasks can pass alone and break together. It merges every passing task in a straight line in a throwaway copy and runs the tests once. A clashing task takes in the tasks it clashes with and goes back through the fix loop; 2 rounds. Skipped with fewer than 2 passing tasks.","src":"scripts/ishikari-build.js (Combined phase)","x":1200,"y":540},{"id":"merger","name":"Merger ant","code":"r3s1","tip":"Merges the approved tasks for real, then checks with git; failures go back to the workers.","about":"Adds every passing task's commits in a straight line, in dependency order, in a scratch copy, and tests once. It reuses build's trial merge when nothing moved. Then it checks its own merge with git cherry and counts changed lines with git diff --shortstat. Never touches main. A conflict, failed tests, or a task git finds missing goes back to the worker ant on its own branch: it merges the current main, fixes the bug, the detective re-checks, the integrator tests again, and finish retries the merge. Tasks that merged cleanly are not rebuilt. At most 2 extra build rounds; what is left drops and is reported.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (Merge phase)","x":200,"y":1080},{"id":"janitor","name":"Janitor ant","code":"r3s2","tip":"Cleans up mess the run left, by itself.","about":"Finds dead code, bloat and duplication from the merged tasks only. In its own worktree it edits, runs the tests and commits, and lands the cleanup only if they pass. Skipped under 100 changed lines, and a cleanup run gets no janitor. Tests failing: the cleanup is dropped, main moves with the tasks alone, its branch is kept, and its note goes to the next run's Task, where the investigator may ask about it.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (Upkeep phase)","x":760,"y":1080},{"id":"jurors","name":"Juror ants","code":"r4s1","tip":"Score each merged task against its plan.","about":"One per merged task, up to 5 at once, only with 3 or more merged tasks. Each scores its task against that task's plan, and the judge weighs their reports.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","x":160,"y":1520},{"id":"judge","name":"Judge ant","code":"r4s2","tip":"Scores the whole run 0-10 against the plans.","about":"Reads the investigation report, architecture and every worker plan, and the merged code with the cleanup on top. One question: does the code match the plans? The score is its own call, not an average. 7 or more, or no gaps: main moves. Below 7 with gaps: one fix round.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","x":400,"y":1520},{"id":"judge-fix-worker","name":"Worker ant","code":"r4s3","tip":"Closes the judge's gaps.","about":"Builds the judge's gaps as one fix on top of the merged scratch copy.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","x":500,"y":1610},{"id":"judge-fix-detective","name":"Detective ant","code":"r4s4","tip":"Checks the judge fix.","about":"Checks the fix and runs the tests. A failed fix keeps its branch and the verdict says why.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","x":660,"y":1610},{"id":"judge-fix-merger","name":"Merger ant","code":"r4s5","tip":"Lands the judge fix by fast-forward.","about":"Fast-forwards the scratch copy to the fix. The fix lands only through this fast-forward.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (merger-ant:judge-fix)","x":820,"y":1610},{"id":"judge-again","name":"Judge ant","code":"r4s6","tip":"Scores again after the fix.","about":"Scores the run a second time. Still below 7: main moves anyway and the verdict is flagged. The judge never blocks main.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js","x":1000,"y":1610},{"id":"finisher","name":"Finisher ant","code":"r4s7","tip":"Moves main, cleans up, runs the check.","about":"Fast-forwards main, which git refuses if it would overwrite local edits. Removes the worktrees, appends the stage's logbook rows, and runs checkCommand when it is set.","src":"scripts/ishikari-finish.js (Main phase)","x":1180,"y":1520},{"id":"main","name":"MAIN","code":"r4s8","tip":"Your main branch, moved forward.","about":"Moves only as a fast-forward, never a merge commit, and is never pushed. Push it yourself when you are happy.","src":"SKILL.md#4-finish","x":1340,"y":1520},{"id":"check","name":"checkCommand","code":"r4s9","tip":"Builds and checks the app after main moves.","about":"The finisher ant runs the repo's saved checkCommand, only when main moved and the command is set. A failure starts one check-fix round. The check-fix round is one build round from the moved main, as a new task named check-fix. If the check still fails after it, the run stops and reports the output, and requirements are not marked done.","src":"ishikari.py config <state> checkCommand <cmd>","x":1580,"y":1520},{"id":"req-done","name":"req done","code":"r4s10","tip":"Marks this run's requirements DONE.","about":"The main session runs ishikari.py req done with the :ID:s kept in planning, once the check passed or there is none. Skipped when the repo has no requirements file.","src":"scripts/ishikari.py (req done)","x":1780,"y":1520},{"id":"train-1","name":"Car 1","code":"","tip":"A sample task riding the plan line.","about":"The numbered cars are sample tasks moving through the run, so you can follow one. Car 1 rides the plan line; the key in the bottom right says what each number shows.","src":"","x":0,"y":0},{"id":"train-2","name":"Car 2","code":"","tip":"A sample task riding the build line.","about":"The numbered cars are sample tasks moving through the run, so you can follow one. Car 2 rides the build line; the key in the bottom right says what each number shows.","src":"","x":0,"y":0},{"id":"train-3","name":"Car 3","code":"","tip":"A sample task riding the build line.","about":"The numbered cars are sample tasks moving through the run, so you can follow one. Car 3 rides the build line; the key in the bottom right says what each number shows.","src":"","x":0,"y":0},{"id":"train-4","name":"Car 4","code":"","tip":"A sample task riding the build line.","about":"The numbered cars are sample tasks moving through the run, so you can follow one. Car 4 rides the build line; the key in the bottom right says what each number shows.","src":"","x":0,"y":0},{"id":"train-5","name":"Car 5","code":"","tip":"A sample task riding the build line.","about":"The numbered cars are sample tasks moving through the run, so you can follow one. var W=2000,H=1960,svg=document.documentElement,pn=document.getElementById('pn'),box=pn.firstChild; function show(i,px,py){var d=D[i];box.querySelector('b').textContent=d.name; box.querySelector('small').textContent=d.id+(d.code?' \u00b7 '+d.code:'');box.querySelector('p').textContent=d.about; box.querySelector('code').textContent=d.src;box.querySelector('code').style.display=d.src?'':'none';pn.classList.add('on'); var ax=px==null?d.x:px,ay=py==null?d.y:py,h=box.offsetHeight||200,x=ax+30,y=ay-20; if(x+420>W-10)x=ax-450;if(x<10)x=10;if(y+h>H-10)y=H-10-h;if(y<10)y=10; pn.setAttribute('x',x);pn.setAttribute('y',y);pn.setAttribute('height',h+4);} function at(e){var p=svg.createSVGPoint();p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;return p.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());} function hide(){pn.classList.remove('on');} document.querySelectorAll('.ck').forEach(function(g){ g.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();var p=at(e);show(+g.dataset.i,p.x,p.y);}); g.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();show(+g.dataset.i);}});}); pn.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();if(e.target.tagName==='i')hide();}); document.addEventListener('click',hide); document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')hide();}); function fromHash(){var id=location.hash.replace(/^#((st|it)-)?/,'');for(var i=0;i<D.length;i++)if(D[i].id===id||D[i].code===id){show(i);return;}} window.addEventListener('hashchange',fromHash);fromHash(); })();
